name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.sphereMonomial_phase
statement:
theorem sphereMonomial_phase (α β γ δ : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) (z : Sphere) :
    sphereMonomial α β γ δ (diagonalPhase θ • z) =
      Complex.exp (((α : ℂ) + δ - β - γ) * Complex.I * θ) * sphereMonomial α β γ δ z
proof:
:= by
  have hc : star (Complex.exp (Complex.I * θ)) = Complex.exp (-Complex.I * θ) := by
    rw [Complex.star_def, ← Complex.exp_conj]
    congr 1
    simp
  have hpow : Complex.exp (Complex.I * θ) ^ (α + δ) *
      star (Complex.exp (Complex.I * θ)) ^ (β + γ) =
      Complex.exp (((α : ℂ) + δ - β - γ) * Complex.I * θ) := by
    rw [hc, ← Complex.exp_nat_mul, ← Complex.exp_nat_mul, ← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [← hpow]
  simp only [sphereMonomial, coordinateMonomial, diagonalPhase_smul, mul_pow, star_mul, star_star, pow_add]
  ring

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.sphereMonomial_integral_zero
statement:
theorem sphereMonomial_integral_zero (α β γ δ : ℕ) (h : α + δ ≠ β + γ) :
    (∫ z, sphereMonomial α β γ δ z ∂surfaceMeasure) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let n : ℝ := (α : ℝ) + δ - β - γ
  have hn : n ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [n]
    intro hn
    have heq : (α : ℝ) + δ = β + γ := by linarith
    exact h (by exact_mod_cast heq)
  have hfreq : ((α : ℂ) + δ - β - γ) * Complex.I * ((Real.pi / n : ℝ) : ℂ) =
      (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
    have hnc : (n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hn
    have hc : (n : ℂ) = (α : ℂ) + δ - β - γ := by simp [n]
    rw [← hc, Complex.ofReal_div]
    field_simp
  have heq := integral_smul_eq_self (μ := surfaceMeasure)
    (sphereMonomial α β γ δ) (g := diagonalPhase (Real.pi / n))
  simp_rw [sphereMonomial_phase, hfreq, Complex.exp_pi_mul_I] at heq
  rw [integral_const_mul] at heq
  linear_combination -heq / 2

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.coordinateMonomial_scaled_integral_zero

theorem coordinateMonomial_scaled_integral_zero (α β γ δ : ℕ)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.betaAverage_add
statement:
theorem betaAverage_add (P Q : CoordinatePolynomial) (x : ℝ) :
    betaAverage (P+Q) x = betaAverage P x + betaAverage Q x
proof:
:= by
  have hi (P : CoordinatePolynomial) (z₁ : Circle) :
      Integrable (betaEval P x z₁) (normalizedHaar Circle) :=
    ((betaEval_continuous P).comp (show Continuous (fun z₂ : Circle => ((x,z₁),z₂)) by fun_prop)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  have hj (P : CoordinatePolynomial) :
      Integrable (fun z₁ => ∫ z₂, betaEval P x z₁ z₂ ∂normalizedHaar Circle) (normalizedHaar Circle) :=
    ((betaInner_continuous P).comp (show Continuous (fun z₁ : Circle => (x,z₁)) by fun_prop)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  unfold betaAverage
  simp_rw [betaEval_add, integral_add (hi P _) (hi Q _)]
  exact integral_add (hj P) (hj Q)

theorem entryCoordinates_monomial (e : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (c : ℂ) (g : SU2) :

proof:
:= by

    Finsupp.prod_fintype _ _ (fun _ => pow_zero _), Fin.prod_univ_succ]
  change c * (g.val 0 0^e 0 * (g.val 1 0^e 1 * (g.val 0 1^e 2 * (g.val 1 1^e 3 * 1)))) = _

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.betaEval_monomial
statement:
theorem betaEval_monomial (e : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (c : ℂ) (x : ℝ) (z₁ z₂ : Circle) :
    betaEval (MvPolynomial.monomial e c) x z₁ z₂ =
      (c * (-1 : ℂ)^e 2 * (1-(x : ℂ))^e 0 * (x : ℂ)^e 1) *
        (z₁ : ℂ)^((e 1 : ℤ)-e 2) * (z₂ : ℂ)^((e 0 : ℤ)-e 3)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [betaEval, MvPolynomial.eval_monomial,
    Finsupp.prod_fintype _ _ (fun _ => pow_zero _), Fin.prod_univ_succ]
  change c * (((1-(x : ℂ))*(z₂ : ℂ))^e 0 * (((x : ℂ)*(z₁ : ℂ))^e 1 *
    ((-((z₁ : ℂ)⁻¹))^e 2 * (((z₂ : ℂ)⁻¹)^e 3 * 1)))) = _
  rw [neg_pow ((z₁ : ℂ)⁻¹) (e 2)]
  simp only [zpow_sub₀ (Circle.coe_ne_zero _), zpow_natCast, div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow, mul_pow]
  ring

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.betaAverage_monomial
statement:
theorem betaAverage_monomial (e : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (c : ℂ) (x : ℝ) :
    betaAverage (MvPolynomial.monomial e c) x =
      if e 0 = e 3 ∧ e 1 = e 2 then c * (-1 : ℂ)^e 1 * (1-(x : ℂ))^e 0 * (x : ℂ)^e 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold betaAverage
  simp_rw [betaEval_monomial, integral_const_mul, integral_mul_const, circle_zpow_integral]
  by_cases h0 : e 0 = e 3 <;> by_cases h1 : e 1 = e 2
  all_goals simp [h0, h1, sub_eq_zero, integral_const_mul, circle_zpow_integral]

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.betaIntegral_monomial
statement:
theorem betaIntegral_monomial (e : Fin 4 →₀ ℕ) (c : ℂ) :
    betaIntegral (MvPolynomial.monomial e c) = c *
      (if e 0 = e 3 ∧ e 1 = e 2 then
        (-1 : ℂ)^e 1 * ((e 0).factorial * ((e 1).factorial : ℂ) / (e 0+e 1+1).factorial) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [betaIntegral, betaAverage_monomial]
  by_cases h : e 0 = e 3 ∧ e 1 = e 2
  · simp only [h, and_self, ite_true]
    simp_rw [mul_assoc]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, beta_factorial]
  · simp [h]

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_integration
statement:
theorem su2_integration (P : CoordinatePolynomial) :
    representativeIntegral SU2 (entryCoordinates P) = betaIntegral P
proof:
:= by
  induction P using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | monomial e c =>
    change (∫ g : SU2, (entryCoordinates (MvPolynomial.monomial e c)).val g ∂normalizedHaar SU2) = _
    simp_rw [entryCoordinates_monomial]
    rw [integral_const_mul, su2_monomial, betaIntegral_monomial]
  | add P Q hP hQ => rw [map_add, map_add, hP, hQ, betaIntegral_add]

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.entryCoordinates_apply
statement:
theorem entryCoordinates_apply (P : CoordinatePolynomial) (g : SU2) :
    (entryCoordinates P).val g =
      MvPolynomial.eval ![g.val 0 0, g.val 1 0, g.val 0 1, g.val 1 1] P
proof:
:= by
  induction P using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C c => simp [entryCoordinates]
  | add P Q hP hQ =>
    simp only [map_add]
    change (entryCoordinates P).val g + (entryCoordinates Q).val g = _
    rw [hP,hQ]
  | mul_X P i hP =>
    simp only [map_mul, entryCoordinates, MvPolynomial.aeval_X, MvPolynomial.eval_X]
    change (entryCoordinates P).val g *
      (![su2Entry 0 0, su2Entry 1 0, su2Entry 0 1, su2Entry 1 1] i).val g = _
    rw [hP]
    fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_integration_formula
statement:
theorem su2_integration_formula (P : CoordinatePolynomial) :
    (∫ g : SU2, MvPolynomial.eval ![g.val 0 0, g.val 1 0, g.val 0 1, g.val 1 1] P
      ∂normalizedHaar SU2) =
    ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, ∫ z₁ : Circle, ∫ z₂ : Circle,
      MvPolynomial.eval ![(1-(x : ℂ))*(z₂ : ℂ), (x : ℂ)*(z₁ : ℂ),
        -(z₁ : ℂ)⁻¹, (z₂ : ℂ)⁻¹] P ∂normalizedHaar Circle ∂normalizedHaar Circle
proof:
:= by
  have h := su2_integration P
  change (∫ g : SU2, (entryCoordinates P).val g ∂normalizedHaar SU2) = _ at h
  simpa only [entryCoordinates_apply, betaIntegral, betaAverage, betaEval, betaPoint, Circle.coe_inv] using h

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.exists_radial_direction
statement:
theorem exists_radial_direction (z : Space) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r ∧ ∃ w : Sphere, z = (r : ℂ) • w.val ∧ r ^ 2 = a z
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hz : z = 0
  · subst z
    refine ⟨0, le_rfl, ⟨(1, 0), by simp [a]⟩, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp [a]
  · let r := Real.sqrt (a z)
    have ha : 0 < a z := lt_of_le_of_ne (a_nonneg z) (Ne.symm ((a_eq_zero_iff z).not.mpr hz))
    have hr : 0 < r := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr ha
    have hr2 : r ^ 2 = a z := Real.sq_sqrt ha.le
    have hc : (r : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hr.ne'
    have hw : a ((r : ℂ)⁻¹ • z) = 1 := by
      rw [a_smul, map_inv₀, Complex.normSq_ofReal]
      rw [← pow_two, ← hr2]
      exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ hr.ne')
    refine ⟨r, hr.le, ⟨(r : ℂ)⁻¹ • z, hw⟩, ?_, hr2⟩
    simp [smul_smul, hc]

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.SU2_transitive_equal_a
statement: theorem SU2_transitive_equal_a (z w : Space) (h : a z = a w) : ∃ g : SU2, g • z = w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, z', hz, hr2⟩ := exists_radial_direction z
  obtain ⟨s, hs, w', hw, hs2⟩ := exists_radial_direction w
  have hrs : r = s := (sq_eq_sq₀ hr hs).mp (hr2.trans (h.trans hs2.symm))
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := SU2_transitive_sphere z' w'
  refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
  rw [hz, hw, hrs, su2_smul_complex]
  exact congrArg (fun x : Sphere => (s : ℂ) • x.val) hg

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.measurePreserving_transitive_orbit
statement:
theorem measurePreserving_transitive_orbit (μ : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    [SMulInvariantMeasure G X μ]
    (htrans : ∀ x y : X, ∃ g : G, g • x = y) (z : X) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun g : G => g • z) (normalizedHaar G) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Measurable (fun g : G => g • z) := (continuous_id.smul continuous_const).measurable
  refine ⟨hc, Measure.ext_of_lintegral _ ?_⟩
  intro f hf
  rw [lintegral_map hf hc]
  have hconstant (x : X) :
      (∫⁻ g : G, f (g • x) ∂normalizedHaar G) = ∫⁻ g : G, f (g • z) ∂normalizedHaar G := by
    obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := htrans z x
    simpa only [mul_smul] using
      lintegral_mul_right_eq_self (μ := normalizedHaar G) (fun g : G => f (g • z)) h
  calc
    (∫⁻ g : G, f (g • z) ∂normalizedHaar G) =
        ∫⁻ x : X, ∫⁻ g : G, f (g • x) ∂normalizedHaar G ∂μ := by simp [hconstant]
    _ = ∫⁻ g : G, ∫⁻ x : X, f (g • x) ∂μ ∂normalizedHaar G := by
      apply lintegral_lintegral_swap
      exact (hf.comp (continuous_snd.smul continuous_fst).measurable).aemeasurable
    _ = ∫⁻ x : X, f x ∂μ := by
      simp_rw [(measurePreserving_smul _ μ).lintegral_comp hf]
      simp

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.betaTriple_F
statement: theorem betaTriple_F (lam μ : ℂ) : betaTriple (FPolynomial lam μ) = circuit 1 lam μ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [FPolynomial, betaTriple, map_mul, map_add, map_one,
    MvPolynomial.aeval_C, MvPolynomial.aeval_X]
  change LaurentPolynomial.C (Polynomial.C lam) *
    (1 + LaurentPolynomial.C (Polynomial.C μ) * (-LaurentPolynomial.T (-1))) *
    (LaurentPolynomial.C (1-Polynomial.X) + LaurentPolynomial.C (Polynomial.C μ⁻¹) *
      (LaurentPolynomial.C Polynomial.X * LaurentPolynomial.T 1)) = _
  simp only [circuit, map_mul]
  ring

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.betaTriple_G

:= by

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_pure
statement:
theorem su2_pure (lam μ : ℂ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    representativeIntegral SU2 (su2F lam μ ^ n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [su2F, ← map_pow, su2_polynomial_transfer, map_pow, betaTriple_F]
  exact circuit_pure 1 (by omega) lam μ hμ n hn

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_marked
statement:
theorem su2_marked (lam μ : ℂ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    representativeIntegral SU2 (su2G * su2F lam μ ^ n) =
      (-1 : ℂ)^(n-1) * lam^n * μ⁻¹ / (n+1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [su2G, su2F, ← map_pow, ← map_mul, su2_polynomial_transfer,
    map_mul, map_pow, betaTriple_G, betaTriple_F]
  exact circuit_marked 1 (by omega) lam μ hμ n hn

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_marked_ne_zero
statement:
theorem su2_marked_ne_zero (lam μ : ℂ) (hlam : lam ≠ 0) (hμ : μ ≠ 0)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : representativeIntegral SU2 (su2G * su2F lam μ ^ n) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [su2_marked lam μ hμ n hn]
  exact div_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num))
    (pow_ne_zero _ hlam)) (inv_ne_zero hμ)) (by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero n)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.SU2_not_mathieu
statement: theorem SU2_not_mathieu : ¬ HasMathieuProperty SU2
proof:
:=
  not_mathieu_of_representative_witness SU2 (su2F 1 1) su2G
    (su2_pure 1 1 one_ne_zero) (su2_marked_ne_zero 1 1 one_ne_zero one_ne_zero)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_counterexample
statement:
theorem su2_counterexample (lam μ : ℂ) (hlam : lam ≠ 0) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) :
    (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
      (∫ g : SU2, (lam * (1+μ*g.val 0 1) *
        (g.val 0 0*g.val 1 1 + μ⁻¹*g.val 1 0))^n ∂normalizedHaar SU2) = 0) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
      (∫ g : SU2, (lam * (1+μ*g.val 0 1) *
        (g.val 0 0*g.val 1 1 + μ⁻¹*g.val 1 0))^n * (-g.val 0 1) ∂normalizedHaar SU2) =
          (-1 : ℂ)^(n-1) * lam^n * μ⁻¹ / (n+1)) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → (-1 : ℂ)^(n-1) * lam^n * μ⁻¹ / (n+1) ≠ 0) ∧
    ¬ HasMathieuProperty SU2
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, SU2_not_mathieu⟩
  · intro n hn
    have h := su2_pure lam μ hμ n hn
    change (∫ g : SU2, (su2F lam μ).val g ^ n ∂normalizedHaar SU2) = 0 at h
    simpa only [su2F_apply] using h
  · intro n hn
    have h := su2_marked lam μ hμ n hn
    change (∫ g : SU2, su2G.val g * (su2F lam μ).val g ^ n ∂normalizedHaar SU2) = _ at h
    simpa only [su2F_apply, su2G_apply, mul_comm] using h
  · intro n hn
    have h := su2_marked_ne_zero lam μ hlam hμ n hn
    rwa [su2_marked lam μ hμ n hn] at h

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.small_pair
statement:
theorem small_pair (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (∫ g : SU2, ((1+g.val 0 1) * (g.val 0 0*g.val 1 1+g.val 1 0))^n ∂normalizedHaar SU2) = 0 ∧
    (∫ g : SU2, ((1+g.val 0 1) * (g.val 0 0*g.val 1 1+g.val 1 0))^n * (-g.val 0 1)
      ∂normalizedHaar SU2) = (-1 : ℂ)^(n-1)/(n+1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := su2_counterexample 1 1 one_ne_zero one_ne_zero
  exact ⟨by simpa using h.1 n hn, by simpa using h.2.1 n hn⟩

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.HasMathieuProperty.of_surjective
statement:
theorem HasMathieuProperty.of_surjective (hG : HasMathieuProperty G)
    (π : G →* H) (hπ : Continuous π) (hs : Function.Surjective π) : HasMathieuProperty H
proof:
:= by
  have hker : LinearMap.ker (representativeIntegral H) =
      (LinearMap.ker (representativeIntegral G)).comap (representativePullback π hπ).toLinearMap := by
    ext f
    simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, Submodule.mem_comap, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply,
      representativeIntegral_pullback π hπ hs]
  unfold HasMathieuProperty
  rw [hker]
  exact IsMathieuSubspace.comap (A := representativeFunctions (G := H))
    (B := representativeFunctions (G := G)) hG (representativePullback π hπ)

theorem not_mathieuProperty_of_quotient (π : G →* H) (hπ : Continuous π)

proof:
:=

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.representative_counterexample_pullback
statement:
theorem representative_counterexample_pullback (π : G →* H) (hπ : Continuous π)
    (hs : Function.Surjective π) (f h : representativeFunctions (G := H))
    (hpure : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → representativeIntegral H (f ^ m) = 0)
    (hmarked : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → representativeIntegral H (h * f ^ m) ≠ 0) :
    ¬ HasMathieuProperty G
proof:
:=
  counterexample_pullback (A := representativeFunctions (G := H))
    (B := representativeFunctions (G := G)) (representativePullback π hπ) (representativeIntegral H)
    (representativeIntegral G) (representativeIntegral_pullback π hπ hs) f h hpure hmarked

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.not_isMathieuSubspace_of_witness
statement:
theorem not_isMathieuSubspace_of_witness (M : Submodule K A) (f h : A)
    (hpure : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → f ^ m ∈ M)
    (hmarked : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → h * f ^ m ∉ M) :
    ¬ IsMathieuSubspace M
proof:
:= by
  intro hM
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hM f hpure h
  exact hmarked (max N 1) (le_max_right _ _) (hN _ (le_max_left _ _))

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.IsMathieuSubspace.comap
statement:
theorem IsMathieuSubspace.comap {M : Submodule K B} (hM : IsMathieuSubspace M)
    (φ : A →ₐ[K] B) : IsMathieuSubspace (M.comap φ.toLinearMap)
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf h
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hM (φ f) (by simpa using hf) (φ h)
  exact ⟨N, fun m hm => by simpa using hN m hm⟩

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.counterexample_pullback
statement:
theorem counterexample_pullback (φ : A →ₐ[K] B) (I : A →ₗ[K] K) (J : B →ₗ[K] K)
    (hcompat : ∀ f, J (φ f) = I f) (f h : A)
    (hpure : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → I (f ^ m) = 0)
    (hmarked : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → I (h * f ^ m) ≠ 0) :
    ¬ IsMathieuSubspace (LinearMap.ker J)
proof:
:= by
  apply not_isMathieuSubspace_of_witness _ (φ f) (φ h)
  · intro m hm
    change J (φ f ^ m) = 0
    rw [← map_pow, hcompat]
    exact hpure m hm
  · intro m hm
    change J (φ h * φ f ^ m) ≠ 0
    rw [← map_pow, ← map_mul, hcompat]
    exact hmarked m hm

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.bernstein_integral
statement:
theorem bernstein_integral (m j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ m) :
    ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (m.choose j : ℂ) * (t : ℂ) ^ j * (1 - (t : ℂ)) ^ (m - j) =
      1 / (m + 1 : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (t : ℂ) ^ j * (1 - (t : ℂ)) ^ (m - j)) =
      Complex.betaIntegral (j + 1) (m - j + 1 : ℕ) := by
    unfold Complex.betaIntegral
    congr 1
    funext t
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_sub_cancel_right, Complex.cpow_natCast]
  have hs : (j + 1 : ℂ) + (m - j + 1 : ℕ) = ((m + 1 : ℕ) + 1 : ℂ) := by
    push_cast
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hj]
    ring
  have hfac : (m.choose j : ℂ) * j.factorial * (m - j).factorial = m.factorial := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial hj
  simp_rw [mul_assoc (m.choose j : ℂ)]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, hb,
    Complex.betaIntegral_eq_Gamma_mul_div _ _ (by simp; positivity) (by simp; positivity), hs]
  simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, Complex.Gamma_nat_eq_factorial]
  have hg : Complex.Gamma ((m : ℂ) + 1 + 1) = ((m + 1).factorial : ℂ) := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using Complex.Gamma_nat_eq_factorial (m + 1)
  rw [hg]
  have hm : (m.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero m
  have hn : (m + 1 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero m
  rw [Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  field_simp
  exact hfac

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.xzFamily_pow
statement:
theorem xzFamily_pow (t : ℂ) (m : ℕ) :
    xzFamily t ^ m = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
      LaurentPolynomial.C ((m.choose j : ℂ) * t ^ j * (1 - t) ^ (m - j)) *
        (xzA ^ m * LaurentPolynomial.T (j : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [xzFamily, mul_pow, add_pow, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  simp only [mul_pow, LaurentPolynomial.T_pow, mul_one, map_mul, map_pow, map_natCast]
  ring

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.scalarLaurent_C_mul_coeff
statement:
theorem scalarLaurent_C_mul_coeff (c : ℂ) (f : ScalarLaurent) (k : ℤ) :
    (LaurentPolynomial.C c * f).coeff k = c * f.coeff k
proof:
:= by
  change (AddMonoidAlgebra.single 0 c * f).coeff k = _
  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single_mul_apply]
  simp

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.xzFamily_integrated_coeff
statement:
theorem xzFamily_integrated_coeff (m : ℕ) (k : ℤ) :
    ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (xzFamily (t : ℂ) ^ m).coeff k =
      (1 / (m + 1 : ℂ)) * (xzA ^ m * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), LaurentPolynomial.T (j : ℤ)).coeff k
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [xzFamily_pow, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, scalarLaurent_C_mul_coeff]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum (μ := volume)]
  · simp_rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    rw [bernstein_integral m j (by simpa using Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hj))]
  · intro j _
    exact (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun t : ℝ =>
      (m.choose j : ℂ) * (t : ℂ)^j * (1 - (t : ℂ))^(m-j) *
        (xzA^m * LaurentPolynomial.T (j : ℤ)).coeff k)).intervalIntegrable (μ := volume) 0 1

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.scalarLaurent_mul_T_coeff
statement:
theorem scalarLaurent_mul_T_coeff (f : ScalarLaurent) (i k : ℤ) :
    (f * LaurentPolynomial.T i).coeff k = f.coeff (k - i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [LaurentPolynomial.T, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_mul_single_apply, mul_one, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.xzA_pow_coeff_succ
statement:
theorem xzA_pow_coeff_succ (m : ℕ) (k : ℤ) :
    (xzA ^ (m + 1)).coeff k = (xzA ^ m).coeff k - (xzA ^ m).coeff (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_succ, xzA, mul_sub, mul_one, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_sub, Finsupp.sub_apply,
    scalarLaurent_mul_T_coeff]
  rfl

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.xzA_pow_coeff_outside
statement:
theorem xzA_pow_coeff_outside (m : ℕ) (k : ℤ) (hk : k < -(m : ℤ) ∨ 0 < k) :
    (xzA ^ m).coeff k = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing k with
  | zero =>
    have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by omega
    change (LaurentPolynomial.T (0 : ℤ) : ScalarLaurent).coeff k = 0
    rw [LaurentPolynomial.T_apply, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hk0)]
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [xzA_pow_coeff_succ, ih k (by omega), ih (k + 1) (by omega), sub_self]

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.xzA_pow_coeff_bottom
statement: theorem xzA_pow_coeff_bottom (m : ℕ) : (xzA ^ m).coeff (-(m : ℤ)) = (-1 : ℂ) ^ m
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [xzA_pow_coeff_succ, xzA_pow_coeff_outside m _ (Or.inl (by omega))]
    have hk : -((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1 = -(m : ℤ) := by omega
    rw [hk, ih, pow_succ]
    ring

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.xzA_geometric_sum
statement:
theorem xzA_geometric_sum (m : ℕ) :
    xzA * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (LaurentPolynomial.T (j : ℤ) : ScalarLaurent) =
      LaurentPolynomial.T (m : ℤ) - LaurentPolynomial.T (-1)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [xzA]
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, mul_add, ih]
    have hh : (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) : ScalarLaurent) * LaurentPolynomial.T ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
        LaurentPolynomial.T (m : ℤ) := by
      rw [← LaurentPolynomial.T_add]
      congr 1
      omega
    rw [xzA, sub_mul, one_mul, hh]
    ring

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.xzFamily_integral_pure
statement:
theorem xzFamily_integral_pure (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (xzFamily (t : ℂ) ^ m).coeff 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ : ∃ l, m = l + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [xzFamily_integrated_coeff, pow_succ, mul_assoc, xzA_geometric_sum,
    mul_sub, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_sub, Finsupp.sub_apply]
  simp only [scalarLaurent_mul_T_coeff]
  rw [xzA_pow_coeff_outside l _ (Or.inl (by omega)),
    xzA_pow_coeff_outside l _ (Or.inr (by omega)), sub_self, mul_zero]

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.xzFamily_integral_marked
statement:
theorem xzFamily_integral_marked (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (xzFamily (t : ℂ) ^ m).coeff 1 = (-1 : ℂ) ^ (m - 1) / (m + 1 : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ : ∃ l, m = l + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [xzFamily_integrated_coeff, pow_succ, mul_assoc, xzA_geometric_sum,
    mul_sub, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_sub, Finsupp.sub_apply]
  simp only [scalarLaurent_mul_T_coeff]
  rw [xzA_pow_coeff_outside l (1 - -1) (Or.inr (by omega))]
  have hk : (1 : ℤ) - (l + 1 : ℕ) = -(l : ℤ) := by omega
  rw [hk, xzA_pow_coeff_bottom]
  simp [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.bernstein_average
statement:
theorem bernstein_average (n : ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, ((1-(x : ℂ)) + (x : ℂ)*z)^n) =
      (1/(n+1 : ℂ)) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), z^k
proof:
:= by
  have he (x : ℝ) : ((1-(x : ℂ))+(x : ℂ)*z)^n =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1),
        ((n.choose k : ℂ)*(x : ℂ)^k*(1-(x : ℂ))^(n-k))*z^k := by
    rw [add_comm, add_pow]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    simp only [mul_pow]
    ring
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum]
  · simp_rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    rw [bernstein_integral n k (by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hk; omega)]
  · intro k _
    exact (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun x : ℝ =>
      ((n.choose k : ℂ)*(x : ℂ)^k*(1-(x : ℂ))^(n-k))*z^k)).intervalIntegrable 0 1

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.beta_factorial
statement:
theorem beta_factorial (r s : ℕ) :
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1-(x : ℂ))^r * (x : ℂ)^s) =
      (r.factorial : ℂ) * s.factorial / (r+s+1).factorial
proof:
:= by
  have he : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, (1-(x : ℂ))^r * (x : ℂ)^s) =
      Complex.betaIntegral (s+1) (r+1 : ℕ) := by
    unfold Complex.betaIntegral
    congr 1
    funext x
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_sub_cancel_right, Complex.cpow_natCast]
    ring
  rw [he, Complex.betaIntegral_eq_Gamma_mul_div _ _ (by simp; positivity) (by simp; positivity)]
  have hs : (s+1 : ℂ) + (r+1 : ℕ) = ((r+s+1 : ℕ)+1 : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
  rw [hs]
  simp only [Complex.Gamma_nat_eq_factorial]
  have hg (n : ℕ) : Complex.Gamma ((n : ℂ)+1) = (n.factorial : ℂ) :=
    Complex.Gamma_nat_eq_factorial n
  simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, hg]
  ring

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.entryTriple_monomial
statement:
theorem entryTriple_monomial (e : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (c : ℂ) (g : SU2) :
    (entryTriple (MvPolynomial.monomial e c)).val g =
      c * entryMonomial (e 0) (e 1) (e 2) (e 0) g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [entryTriple, MvPolynomial.aeval_monomial,
    Finsupp.prod_fintype _ _ (fun _ => pow_zero _), Fin.prod_univ_succ]
  change c * ((g.val 0 0 * g.val 1 1)^e 0 *
    (g.val 1 0^e 1 * (g.val 0 1^e 2 * 1))) = _
  simp only [entryMonomial, mul_pow]
  ring

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.betaTriple_monomial
statement:
theorem betaTriple_monomial (e : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (c : ℂ) :
    betaTriple (MvPolynomial.monomial e c) =
      LaurentPolynomial.C (C (c * (-1)^e 2) * (1-X)^e 0 * X^e 1) *
        LaurentPolynomial.T ((e 1 : ℤ) - e 2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [betaTriple, MvPolynomial.aeval_monomial,
    Finsupp.prod_fintype _ _ (fun _ => pow_zero _), Fin.prod_univ_succ]
  change LaurentPolynomial.C (C c) * (LaurentPolynomial.C (1-X)^e 0 *
    ((LaurentPolynomial.C X * LaurentPolynomial.T 1)^e 1 *
    ((-LaurentPolynomial.T (-1))^e 2 * 1))) = _
  rw [neg_pow (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) : Laurent) (e 2)]
  simp only [mul_pow, mul_one, LaurentPolynomial.T_pow,
    map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one]
  rw [show ((e 1 : ℤ) - e 2) = (e 1 : ℤ)*1 + (e 2 : ℤ)*(-1) by ring,
    LaurentPolynomial.T_add]
  simp only [mul_neg_one, mul_one]
  ring

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.betaTriple_monomial_integral
statement:
theorem betaTriple_monomial_integral (e : Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) (c : ℂ) :
    integral (betaTriple (MvPolynomial.monomial e c)) =
      c * (if e 1 = e 2 then (-1 : ℂ)^e 1 *
        ((e 0).factorial * ((e 1).factorial : ℂ) / (e 0+e 1+1).factorial) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [betaTriple_monomial]
  unfold integral
  simp only [← LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C_mul_T, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single,
    Finsupp.single_apply]
  by_cases h : e 1 = e 2
  · simp only [h, sub_self, ite_true, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_pow, eval_sub, eval_one, eval_X]
    simp_rw [mul_assoc]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, beta_factorial]
  · have hh : (e 1 : ℤ) - e 2 ≠ 0 := by omega
    simp [hh, h]

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_polynomial_transfer
statement:
theorem su2_polynomial_transfer (P : TriplePolynomial) :
    representativeIntegral SU2 (entryTriple P) = integral (betaTriple P)
proof:
:= by
  induction P using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | monomial e c =>
    change (∫ g : SU2, (entryTriple (MvPolynomial.monomial e c)).val g ∂normalizedHaar SU2) = _
    simp_rw [entryTriple_monomial]
    rw [integral_const_mul, balanced_entry_integral, betaTriple_monomial_integral]
  | add P Q hP hQ =>
    change representativeIntegral SU2 (entryTriple (P+Q)) = integralLinear (betaTriple (P+Q))
    rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, hP, hQ]
    rfl

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.multiEval_continuous
statement:
theorem multiEval_continuous {k l : ℕ} (x : Fin l → ℝ) (f : MultiLaurent k l) :
    Continuous (fun z : Fin k → Circle => multiEval x z f)
proof:
:= by
  induction f using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => simpa only [map_zero] using (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : Fin k → Circle => (0 : ℂ)))
  | add f g hf hg =>
    have he : (fun z => multiEval x z (f+g)) = (fun z => multiEval x z f) + (fun z => multiEval x z g) := by
      funext z; exact map_add _ _ _
    rw [he]; exact hf.add hg
  | single e p =>
    simp_rw [multiEval_single]
    apply continuous_const.mul
    apply continuous_finsetProd
    intro j _
    exact (continuous_subtype_val.comp (continuous_apply j)).zpow₀ (e j)
      (fun z => Or.inl (Circle.coe_ne_zero (z j)))

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.multiCircle_constantTerm
statement:
theorem multiCircle_constantTerm {k l : ℕ} (x : Fin l → ℝ) (f : MultiLaurent k l) :
    (∫ z, multiEval x z f ∂torusMeasure k) = MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => (x i : ℂ)) (f.coeff 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction f using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add f g hf hg =>
    simp only [map_add, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply]
    rw [integral_add ((multiEval_continuous x f).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)) ((multiEval_continuous x g).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)), hf, hg]
  | single e p =>
    simp_rw [multiEval_single]
    rw [integral_const_mul]
    unfold torusMeasure
    rw [integral_fintype_prod_eq_prod (fun j (z : Circle) => (z : ℂ)^(e j))
      (μ := fun _ : Fin k => normalizedHaar Circle)]
    simp_rw [circle_zpow_integral]
    by_cases he : e = 0
    · subst e; simp
    · obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp he
      have hp : (∏ i : Fin k, if e i = 0 then (1 : ℂ) else 0) = 0 :=
        Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ j) (by simpa using hj)
      rw [hp]
      simp [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, he]

theorem multiIntegral_eq_product {k l : ℕ} (f : MultiLaurent k l) :

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.surface_cone_preimage
statement:
theorem surface_cone_preimage (e : EuclideanPair ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanPair)
    (S : Set (Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanPair) 1)) :
    Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 • (Subtype.val '' (euclideanSphereAction e ⁻¹' S)) =
      e ⁻¹' (Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 • (Subtype.val '' S))
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, w, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨r, hr, e z.val, ⟨euclideanSphereAction e z, hz, rfl⟩, (e.map_smul r z.val).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, w, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, heq⟩
    refine ⟨r, hr, e.symm z.val, ⟨euclideanSphereAction e.symm z, ?_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    · have hz' : euclideanSphereAction e (euclideanSphereAction e.symm z) = z := by
        ext; exact e.apply_symm_apply z.val
      simpa only [Set.mem_preimage, hz'] using hz
    · apply e.injective
      simpa using heq

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.euclideanSurface_preserving

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.integrable_orbit_function
statement:
theorem integrable_orbit_function (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hμ : IsCompact μ.support) {f : X → ℂ} (hf : Continuous f) :
    Integrable (fun p : G × X => f (p.1 • p.2)) ((normalizedHaar G).prod μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun p : G × X => f (p.1 • p.2)) := hf.comp continuous_smul
  have hi := ContinuousOn.integrableOn_compact (μ := (normalizedHaar G).prod μ)
    (isCompact_univ.prod hμ) hc.continuousOn
  have hmem : ∀ᵐ p : G × X ∂(normalizedHaar G).prod μ, p ∈ Set.univ ×ˢ μ.support := by
    filter_upwards [(Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd (μ := normalizedHaar G) (ν := μ)).ae
      μ.support_mem_ae] with p hp
    exact ⟨Set.mem_univ _, hp⟩
  change Integrable _ (((normalizedHaar G).prod μ).restrict (Set.univ ×ˢ μ.support)) at hi
  rw [Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem hmem] at hi
  exact hi

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.measurePreserving_smul_prod
statement:
theorem measurePreserving_smul_prod (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    [SMulInvariantMeasure G X μ] :
    MeasurePreserving (fun p : G × X => p.1 • p.2) ((normalizedHaar G).prod μ) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Measurable (fun p : G × X => p.1 • p.2) := continuous_smul.measurable
  refine ⟨hc, ?_⟩
  apply Measure.ext
  intro S hS
  rw [Measure.map_apply hc hS, Measure.prod_apply (hc hS)]
  have hsections (g : G) : μ (Prod.mk g ⁻¹' ((fun p : G × X => p.1 • p.2) ⁻¹' S)) = μ S :=
    SMulInvariantMeasure.measure_preimage_smul g hS
  simp_rw [hsections]
  simp

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.orbit_average_integrable
statement:
theorem orbit_average_integrable (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    [SMulInvariantMeasure G X μ] {f : X → ℂ} (hf : Integrable f μ) :
    (∫ x, (∫ g, f (g • x) ∂normalizedHaar G) ∂μ) = ∫ x, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hi := (measurePreserving_smul_prod (G := G) μ).integrable_comp_of_integrable hf
  rw [← integral_integral_swap (f := fun (g : G) (x : X) => f (g • x)) hi]
  simp only [integral_smul_eq_self]
  simp

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.orbit_average
statement:
theorem orbit_average (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [SMulInvariantMeasure G X μ]

    (∫ x, (∫ g, f (g • x) ∂normalizedHaar G) ∂μ) = ∫ x, f x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← integral_integral_swap (integrable_orbit_function (G := G) μ hμ hf)]

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circle_zpow_integral
statement:
theorem circle_zpow_integral (k : ℤ) :
    (∫ z : Circle, (z : ℂ)^k ∂normalizedHaar Circle) = if k = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · simp [hk]
  rw [ite_eq_right hk]
  have hz : ((Circle.exp (Real.pi / k) : Circle) : ℂ)^k = -1 := by
    rw [Circle.coe_exp, ← Complex.exp_int_mul]
    have hc : (k : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hk
    have he : (k : ℂ) * (((Real.pi / k : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = Real.pi * Complex.I := by
      push_cast
      field_simp
    rw [he, Complex.exp_pi_mul_I]
  have h := integral_mul_left_eq_self (μ := normalizedHaar Circle)
    (fun z : Circle => (z : ℂ)^k) (Circle.exp (Real.pi / k))
  simp only [Circle.coe_mul, mul_zpow, hz, integral_const_mul] at h
  linear_combination -h / 2

proof:

  | add f g hf hg =>
    have he : (fun z : Circle => circleEval z (f+g)) =
        (fun z => circleEval z f) + (fun z => circleEval z g) := by
      funext z
      exact map_add (circleEval z) f g
    rw [he]
    exact hf.add hg
  | C_mul_T k c =>

  | add f g hf hg =>
    simp only [map_add, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply]
    rw [integral_add ((circleEval_continuous f).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)) ((circleEval_continuous g).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)), hf, hg]
  | C_mul_T k c =>
    simp_rw [circleEval_monomial]
    rw [integral_const_mul, circle_zpow_integral]
    simp only [← LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C_mul_T, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single,

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.rotationMomentPolynomial_coeff_one
statement:
theorem rotationMomentPolynomial_coeff_one (p q : ℕ) (z : Sphere) :
    (rotationMomentPolynomial p q).coeff 1 z =
      -(p + 1 : ℂ) * sphereMonomial p p (q + 1) (q + 1) z -
      (p : ℂ) * sphereMonomial (p + 1) (p - 1) q (q + 2) z +
      (q : ℂ) * sphereMonomial (p + 2) p (q - 1) (q + 1) z +
      (q + 1 : ℂ) * sphereMonomial (p + 1) (p + 1) q q z
proof:
:= by
  have hc (f : Polynomial C(Sphere, ℂ)) : f.coeff 1 = f.derivative.eval 0 := by
    rw [← coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, coeff_derivative]
    simp
  rw [hc]
  simp only [rotationMomentPolynomial, derivative_mul, derivative_pow, derivative_sub,
    derivative_add, derivative_C, derivative_X, eval_mul, eval_add, eval_sub, eval_pow,
    eval_C, eval_X, eval_zero]

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.mixedMoment_balance
statement:
theorem mixedMoment_balance (p q : ℕ) :
    (q + 1 : ℂ) * mixedMoment (p + 1) q = (p + 1 : ℂ) * mixedMoment p (q + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun f : Polynomial ℂ => f.coeff 1)
    (rotationMomentPolynomial_integral_zero p q)
  rw [integrateCoefficients_coeff, coeff_zero] at h
  simp_rw [rotationMomentPolynomial_coeff_one] at h
  have h1 := (sphereMonomial_integrable p p (q + 1) (q + 1)).const_mul (-(p + 1 : ℂ))
  have h2 := (sphereMonomial_integrable (p + 1) (p - 1) q (q + 2)).const_mul (p : ℂ)
  have h3 := (sphereMonomial_integrable (p + 2) p (q - 1) (q + 1)).const_mul (q : ℂ)
  have h4 := (sphereMonomial_integrable (p + 1) (p + 1) q q).const_mul (q + 1 : ℂ)
  have hsum := integral_add ((h1.sub h2).add h3) h4
  have hsum' := integral_add (h1.sub h2) h3
  have hsub := integral_sub h1 h2
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply] at hsum hsum' hsub
  rw [hsum, hsum', hsub] at h
  simp_rw [integral_const_mul] at h
  rw [sphereMonomial_integral_zero (p + 1) (p - 1) q (q + 2) (by omega),
    sphereMonomial_integral_zero (p + 2) p (q - 1) (q + 1) (by omega)] at h
  unfold mixedMoment
  linear_combination h

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.mixedMoment_partition
statement:
theorem mixedMoment_partition (p q : ℕ) :
    mixedMoment p q = mixedMoment (p + 1) q + mixedMoment p (q + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hpoint (z : Sphere) : sphereMonomial p p q q z =
      sphereMonomial (p + 1) (p + 1) q q z + sphereMonomial p p (q + 1) (q + 1) z := by
    have hz : z.val.1 * star z.val.1 + z.val.2 * star z.val.2 = 1 := by
      simpa [a, Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self, mul_comm] using congrArg Complex.ofReal z.property
    simp only [sphereMonomial, coordinateMonomial, pow_succ]
    linear_combination -z.val.1 ^ p * star z.val.1 ^ p * z.val.2 ^ q * star z.val.2 ^ q * hz
  unfold mixedMoment
  simp_rw [hpoint]
  exact integral_add (sphereMonomial_integrable (p + 1) (p + 1) q q)
    (sphereMonomial_integrable p p (q + 1) (q + 1))

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.mixedMoment_succ_left
statement:
theorem mixedMoment_succ_left (p q : ℕ) :
    mixedMoment (p + 1) q = (p + 1 : ℂ) / (p + q + 2 : ℂ) * mixedMoment p q
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (p + q + 2 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (by omega : p + q + 2 ≠ 0)
  apply (mul_left_cancel₀ hn)
  field_simp
  linear_combination -(p + 1 : ℂ) * mixedMoment_partition p q + mixedMoment_balance p q

proof:

    exact_mod_cast (by omega : p + q + 2 ≠ 0)
  apply (mul_left_cancel₀ hn)

  linear_combination -(q + 1 : ℂ) * mixedMoment_partition p q - mixedMoment_balance p q

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.mixedMoment_factorial
statement:
theorem mixedMoment_factorial (p q : ℕ) :
    mixedMoment p q = (p.factorial : ℂ) * q.factorial / (p + q + 1).factorial
proof:
:= by
  have hf (n : ℕ) : (n.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero n
  induction p with
  | zero =>
    induction q with
    | zero => simp [mixedMoment_zero_zero]
    | succ q ih =>
      rw [mixedMoment_succ_right, ih]
      simp only [Nat.zero_add, Nat.factorial_zero, Nat.cast_one, one_mul,
        Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add]
      have hq : (q + 1 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : q + 1 ≠ 0)
      have hq' : (q + 2 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : q + 2 ≠ 0)
      field_simp
      ring
  | succ p ih =>
    rw [mixedMoment_succ_left, ih]
    rw [show p + 1 + q + 1 = (p + q + 1) + 1 by omega]
    simp only [Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    have hpq : (p + q + 1 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : p + q + 1 ≠ 0)
    have hpq' : (p + q + 2 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : p + q + 2 ≠ 0)
    have hadd : (p : ℂ) + q + 1 + 1 = p + q + 2 := by ring
    field_simp [hf, hpq, hpq', hadd]
    ring

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2Entry_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem su2Entry_apply (i j : Fin 2) (g : SU2) : (su2Entry i j).val g = g.val i j
proof: := rfl

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_smul_basePoint
statement: theorem su2_smul_basePoint (g : SU2) : g • basePoint = su2ToSphere g
proof:
:= by

  change g • ((1,0) : Space) = (g.val 0 0, g.val 1 0)
  simp [su2_smul_apply]

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_firstColumn_integral
statement:
theorem su2_firstColumn_integral {f : Sphere → ℂ} (hf : Continuous f) :
    (∫ g : SU2, f (su2ToSphere g) ∂normalizedHaar SU2) = ∫ z, f z ∂surfaceMeasure
proof:
:= by

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.continuous_entryMonomial
statement:
@[fun_prop] theorem continuous_entryMonomial (r s t u : ℕ) :
    Continuous (entryMonomial r s t u)
proof:
:=
  (((continuous_subtype_val.matrix_elem 0 0).pow r).mul
    ((continuous_subtype_val.matrix_elem 1 0).pow s)).mul
    ((continuous_subtype_val.matrix_elem 0 1).pow t) |>.mul
    ((continuous_subtype_val.matrix_elem 1 1).pow u)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.entryMonomial_sphere
statement:
theorem entryMonomial_sphere (r s t u : ℕ) (g : SU2) :
    entryMonomial r s t u g = (-1 : ℂ)^t * sphereMonomial r u s t (su2ToSphere g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [entryMonomial, (su2_entries g).1, (su2_entries g).2]
  change g.val 0 0 ^ r * g.val 1 0 ^ s * (-star (g.val 1 0))^t * star (g.val 0 0)^u =
    (-1 : ℂ)^t * (g.val 0 0 ^ r * star (g.val 0 0)^u * g.val 1 0^s * star (g.val 1 0)^t)
  rw [neg_pow]
  ring

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.entryMonomial_integral_left_zero
statement:
theorem entryMonomial_integral_left_zero (r s t u : ℕ) (h : r+t ≠ u+s) :
    (∫ g : SU2, entryMonomial r s t u g ∂normalizedHaar SU2) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [entryMonomial_sphere]
  rw [integral_const_mul, su2_firstColumn_integral (continuous_sphereMonomial r u s t),
    sphereMonomial_integral_zero r u s t h, mul_zero]

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.entryMonomial_integral_diagonal
statement:
theorem entryMonomial_integral_diagonal (r s : ℕ) :
    (∫ g : SU2, entryMonomial r s s r g ∂normalizedHaar SU2) =
      (-1 : ℂ)^s * ((r.factorial : ℂ) * s.factorial / (r+s+1).factorial)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [entryMonomial_sphere]
  rw [integral_const_mul, su2_firstColumn_integral (continuous_sphereMonomial r r s s)]
  rw [← mixedMoment, mixedMoment_factorial]

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.balanced_entry_integral
statement:
theorem balanced_entry_integral (r s t : ℕ) :
    (∫ g : SU2, entryMonomial r s t r g ∂normalizedHaar SU2) =
      if s = t then (-1 : ℂ)^s * ((r.factorial : ℂ) * s.factorial / (r+s+1).factorial) else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · subst t; exact entryMonomial_integral_diagonal r s
  · exact entryMonomial_integral_left_zero r s t r (by omega)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_determinant_relation
statement:
theorem su2_determinant_relation (g : SU2) :
    g.val 0 0 * g.val 1 1 - g.val 1 0 * g.val 0 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := (Matrix.mem_specialUnitaryGroup_iff.mp g.property).2
  simpa [Matrix.det_fin_two, mul_comm] using h

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.entryMonomial_right_phase
statement:
theorem entryMonomial_right_phase (r s t u : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) (g : SU2) :
    entryMonomial r s t u (g * diagonalPhase θ) =
      Complex.exp (((r : ℂ)+s-t-u)*Complex.I*θ) * entryMonomial r s t u g
proof:
:= by
  have hc : star (Complex.exp (Complex.I * θ)) = Complex.exp (-Complex.I * θ) := by
    rw [Complex.star_def, ← Complex.exp_conj]
    congr 1
    simp
  have hpow : Complex.exp (Complex.I * θ)^(r+s) *
      star (Complex.exp (Complex.I * θ))^(t+u) =
      Complex.exp (((r : ℂ)+s-t-u)*Complex.I*θ) := by
    rw [hc, ← Complex.exp_nat_mul, ← Complex.exp_nat_mul, ← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [← hpow]
  simp only [entryMonomial, diagonalPhase, sphereToSU2, sphereMatrix,
    Submonoid.coe_mul, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  simp [Matrix.of_apply, mul_pow, pow_add]
  ring

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.entryMonomial_integral_right_zero
statement:
theorem entryMonomial_integral_right_zero (r s t u : ℕ) (h : r+s ≠ t+u) :
    (∫ g : SU2, entryMonomial r s t u g ∂normalizedHaar SU2) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let n : ℝ := (r : ℝ)+s-t-u
  have hn : n ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [n]
    intro hn
    have he : (r : ℝ)+s = t+u := by linarith
    exact h (by exact_mod_cast he)
  have hfreq : ((r : ℂ)+s-t-u)*Complex.I*((Real.pi/n : ℝ) : ℂ) = Real.pi*Complex.I := by
    have hnc : (n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hn
    have hc : (n : ℂ) = (r : ℂ)+s-t-u := by simp [n]
    rw [← hc, Complex.ofReal_div]
    field_simp
  have he := integral_mul_right_eq_self (μ := normalizedHaar SU2)
    (entryMonomial r s t u) (diagonalPhase (Real.pi/n))
  simp_rw [entryMonomial_right_phase, hfreq, Complex.exp_pi_mul_I] at he
  rw [integral_const_mul] at he
  linear_combination -he/2

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_monomial
statement:
theorem su2_monomial (r s t u : ℕ) :
    (∫ g : SU2, entryMonomial r s t u g ∂normalizedHaar SU2) =
      if r = u ∧ s = t then
        (-1 : ℂ)^s * ((r.factorial : ℂ)*s.factorial/(r+s+1).factorial) else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : r = u ∧ s = t
  · rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
    rw [ite_eq_left ⟨rfl,rfl⟩]
    exact entryMonomial_integral_diagonal _ _
  · rw [ite_eq_right h]
    by_cases hl : r+t = u+s
    · exact entryMonomial_integral_right_zero r s t u (by omega)
    · exact entryMonomial_integral_left_zero r s t u hl

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.sphereMatrix_mem
statement: theorem sphereMatrix_mem (z : Sphere) : sphereMatrix z ∈ Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ
proof:
:= by
  have hz : z.val.1 * star z.val.1 + z.val.2 * star z.val.2 = 1 := by
    simpa [a, Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self, mul_comm] using congrArg Complex.ofReal z.property
  simp only [Complex.star_def] at hz
  rw [Matrix.mem_specialUnitaryGroup_iff, Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff]
  constructor
  · ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      simp [sphereMatrix, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,
        Matrix.conjTranspose_apply] <;> first | (solve | ring) | linear_combination hz
  · simpa [sphereMatrix, Matrix.det_fin_two, mul_comm] using hz

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_star_eq_adjugate
statement: theorem su2_star_eq_adjugate (g : SU2) : star g.val = g.val.adjugate
proof:
:= by
  have hg := Matrix.mem_specialUnitaryGroup_iff.mp g.property
  apply left_inv_eq_right_inv hg.1.1
  rw [Matrix.mul_adjugate, hg.2, one_smul]

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_entries
statement:
theorem su2_entries (g : SU2) :
    g.val 0 1 = -star (g.val 1 0) ∧ g.val 1 1 = star (g.val 0 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h := su2_star_eq_adjugate g
  have h01 := congrArg (fun A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ => A 1 0) h
  have h00 := congrArg (fun A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ => A 0 0) h
  simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two] at h01 h00
  constructor
  · apply star_injective
    simpa using h01
  · exact h00.symm

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_first_column
statement: theorem su2_first_column (g : SU2) : a (g.val 0 0, g.val 1 0) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := (Matrix.mem_specialUnitaryGroup_iff.mp g.property).1.1
  have h00 := congrArg (fun A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ => A 0 0) h
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_apply] at h00
  apply Complex.ofReal_injective
  simpa [a, Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self, mul_comm] using h00

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2Linear_apply
statement:
theorem su2Linear_apply (g : SU2) (z : Space) :
    su2Linear g z = (g.val 0 0 * z.1 + g.val 0 1 * z.2,
      g.val 1 0 * z.1 + g.val 1 1 * z.2)
proof:
:= by
  change ((g.val *ᵥ ![z.1, z.2]) 0, (g.val *ᵥ ![z.1, z.2]) 1) = _
  simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two]

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2Linear_a
statement: theorem su2Linear_a (g : SU2) (z : Space) : a (su2Linear g z) = a z
proof:
:= by
  have h := su2_first_column g
  rw [su2Linear_apply, (su2_entries g).1, (su2_entries g).2]
  have heq : a (g.val 0 0 * z.1 + -star (g.val 1 0) * z.2,
      g.val 1 0 * z.1 + star (g.val 0 0) * z.2) =
      a (g.val 0 0, g.val 1 0) * a z := by
    simp [a, Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
    ring
  rw [heq, h, one_mul]

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2Linear_one
statement: theorem su2Linear_one (z : Space) : su2Linear 1 z = z
proof:
:= by

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2Linear_mul
statement:
theorem su2Linear_mul (g h : SU2) (z : Space) :
    su2Linear (g * h) z = su2Linear g (su2Linear h z)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [su2Linear_apply, Submonoid.coe_mul, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  ext <;> dsimp <;> ring

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_smul_apply
statement:
theorem su2_smul_apply (g : SU2) (z : Space) :
    g • z = (g.val 0 0 * z.1 + g.val 0 1 * z.2,

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.su2_smul_val
statement: theorem su2_smul_val (g : SU2) (z : Sphere) : (g • z).val = g • z.val

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.sphereToSU2_smul
statement: theorem sphereToSU2_smul (z : Sphere) : sphereToSU2 z • ((1, 0) : Space) = z.val
proof:

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.Hopf.SU2_transitive_sphere
statement: theorem SU2_transitive_sphere (z w : Sphere) : ∃ g : SU2, g • z = w
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨sphereToSU2 w * (sphereToSU2 z)⁻¹, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [su2_smul_val]
  have hz : (sphereToSU2 z)⁻¹ • z.val = ((1, 0) : Space) := by

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.alternating_row
statement:
theorem alternating_row (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (-1 : ℂ)^k * n.choose k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast Int.alternating_sum_range_choose_of_ne (n := n) (by omega)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.alternating_partial_row
statement:

    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (-1 : ℂ)^k * n.choose k) = (-1 : ℂ)^(n-1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m,rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m+1 := ⟨n-1, by omega⟩
  have h := Int.alternating_sum_range_choose_eq_choose (n := m) (m := m)
  simp only [Nat.choose_self, Nat.cast_one, mul_one, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h ⊢
  exact_mod_cast h

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.cancellation_mechanism
statement:
theorem cancellation_mechanism (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (-1 : ℂ)^k * n.choose k) = 0 ∧
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (-1 : ℂ)^k * n.choose k) = (-1 : ℂ)^(n-1) ∧
    integral (basic^n) = 0 ∧ integral (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) * basic^n) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨alternating_row n hn, alternating_partial_row n hn, basic_pure n hn, basic_marked_ne_zero n hn⟩

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.basic_specialize
statement: theorem basic_specialize (x : ℂ) : specialize x basic = xzFamily x
proof:
:= by

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.basic_pure
statement: theorem basic_pure (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : integral (basic ^ n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold integral
  simp_rw [← specialize_coeff, map_pow, basic_specialize]

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.basic_marked
statement:
theorem basic_marked (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    integral (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) * basic ^ n) = (-1 : ℂ) ^ (n-1) / (n+1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold integral
  have he : (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) * basic ^ n).coeff 0 = (basic ^ n).coeff 1 := by
    simp only [LaurentPolynomial.T, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single_mul_apply, one_mul]
    rfl
  rw [he]
  simp_rw [← specialize_coeff, map_pow, basic_specialize]
  exact xzFamily_integral_marked n hn

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.basic_marked_ne_zero
statement:
theorem basic_marked_ne_zero (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    integral (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) * basic ^ n) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [basic_marked n hn]
  exact div_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)) (by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero n)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.basic_expansion
statement:
theorem basic_expansion : basic =
    LaurentPolynomial.C (X - 1) * LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) +
    LaurentPolynomial.C (1 - 2 * X) +
    LaurentPolynomial.C (X) * LaurentPolynomial.T 1
proof:
:= by
  have ht : (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) : Laurent) * LaurentPolynomial.T 1 = 1 := by
    rw [← LaurentPolynomial.T_add]
    norm_num
  simp only [basic, map_sub, map_one, map_mul, map_ofNat]
  linear_combination -LaurentPolynomial.C (X) * ht

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.basic_coeff
statement:
theorem basic_coeff (k : ℤ) : basic.coeff k =
    (if k = -1 then X - 1 else 0) +
    (if k = 0 then 1 - 2 * X else 0) +
    (if k = 1 then X else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [basic_expansion]
  simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply,
    ← LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C_mul_T, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single,
    LaurentPolynomial.C_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
  simp [eq_comm]

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.basic_spectrum
statement: theorem basic_spectrum : basic.coeff.support = {-1, 0, 1}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hneg : (X - 1 : ℂ[X]) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hh := congrArg (Polynomial.eval (2 : ℂ)) h
    norm_num at hh
  have hzero : (1 - 2 * X : ℂ[X]) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hh := congrArg (Polynomial.eval (2 : ℂ)) h
    norm_num at hh
  ext k
  simp only [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, basic_coeff, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
  by_cases hkneg : k = -1
  · subst k; simpa using hneg
  by_cases hkzero : k = 0
  · subst k; simpa using hzero
  by_cases hkpos : k = 1
  · subst k; simp
  · simp [hkneg, hkzero, hkpos]

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.basic_zero_mem_convexHull
statement:
theorem basic_zero_mem_convexHull : (0 : ℝ) ∈
    convexHull ℝ ((fun k : ℤ => (k : ℝ)) '' (basic.coeff.support : Set ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  apply subset_convexHull ℝ
  exact ⟨0, by simp [basic_spectrum], by simp⟩

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.not_XZConjecture
statement: theorem not_XZConjecture : ¬ XZConjecture
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact h basic basic_pure basic_zero_mem_convexHull

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.kernel_not_mathieu
statement: theorem kernel_not_mathieu : ¬ IsMathieuSubspace (LinearMap.ker integralLinear)
proof:
:=
  not_isMathieuSubspace_of_witness _ basic (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1))
    basic_pure basic_marked_ne_zero

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.basic_xz
statement:
theorem basic_xz :
    (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → integral (basic ^ n) = 0) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → integral (LaurentPolynomial.T (-1) * basic ^ n) =
      (-1 : ℂ) ^ (n-1) / (n+1)) ∧
    basic.coeff.support = {-1,0,1} ∧ ¬ XZConjecture ∧
    ¬ IsMathieuSubspace (LinearMap.ker integralLinear)
proof:
:=
  ⟨basic_pure, basic_marked, basic_spectrum, not_XZConjecture, kernel_not_mathieu⟩

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circuitMap_single
statement:
theorem circuitMap_single (d k : ℤ) (μ : ℂ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) (p : ℂ[X]) :
    circuitMap d μ hμ (LC p * LT k) = LC (p * C (μ ^ (-k))) * LT (d*k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C_mul_T]
  rw [circuitMap, AddMonoidAlgebra.liftNCRingHom_single]
  change LC p * (LC (C (μ ^ (-k))) * LT (d*k)) = _
  rw [map_mul, mul_assoc]

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circuitMap_C
statement:
theorem circuitMap_C (d : ℤ) (μ : ℂ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) (p : ℂ[X]) :
    circuitMap d μ hμ (LC p) = LC p
proof:
:= by
  simpa using circuitMap_single d 0 μ hμ p

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circuitMap_T
statement:
theorem circuitMap_T (d k : ℤ) (μ : ℂ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) :
    circuitMap d μ hμ (LT k) = LC (C (μ ^ (-k))) * LT (d*k)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using circuitMap_single d k μ hμ 1

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circuitMap_coeff
statement:
theorem circuitMap_coeff (d : ℤ) (hd : d ≠ 0) (μ : ℂ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0)
    (f : Laurent) (k : ℤ) :
    (circuitMap d μ hμ f).coeff (d*k) = f.coeff k * C (μ ^ (-k))
proof:
:= by
  induction f using LaurentPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | add f g hf hg => simp [hf, hg, add_mul]
  | C_mul_T j p =>
    rw [circuitMap_single]
    simp only [← LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C_mul_T, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single,
      Finsupp.single_apply, mul_eq_mul_left_iff, hd, or_false]
    split_ifs with h
    · subst j; rfl
    · simp

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circuit_eq_map
statement:
theorem circuit_eq_map (d : ℤ) (lam μ : ℂ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) :
    circuit d lam μ = LC (C lam) * circuitMap d μ hμ basic
proof:
:= by
  simp [basic, circuit, circuitMap_C, circuitMap_T, map_mul]
  ring

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circuit_moment_coeff
statement:
theorem circuit_moment_coeff (d : ℤ) (hd : d ≠ 0) (lam μ : ℂ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0)
    (n : ℕ) (k : ℤ) :
    (circuit d lam μ ^ n).coeff (d*k) = C (lam^n * μ^(-k)) * (basic ^ n).coeff k
proof:
:= by
  rw [circuit_eq_map d lam μ hμ, mul_pow, ← map_pow, ← map_pow, ← map_pow]
  change (LC (C (lam ^ n)) * circuitMap d μ hμ (basic ^ n)).coeff (d*k) = _
  rw [show ∀ (p : ℂ[X]) (f : Laurent) (j : ℤ), (LC p * f).coeff j = p * f.coeff j from
    fun p f j => by
      change (AddMonoidAlgebra.single 0 p * f).coeff j = _
      rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single_mul_apply]; simp]
  rw [circuitMap_coeff d hd μ hμ, map_mul]
  ring

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circuit_pure
statement:
theorem circuit_pure (d : ℤ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (lam μ : ℂ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : integral (circuit d lam μ ^ n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hc := circuit_moment_coeff d (by omega) lam μ hμ n 0
  simp only [mul_zero, neg_zero, zpow_zero, mul_one] at hc
  simp only [integral, hc, eval_mul, eval_C]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  change lam ^ n * integral (basic ^ n) = 0
  rw [basic_pure n hn, mul_zero]

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circuit_marked
statement:
theorem circuit_marked (d : ℤ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (lam μ : ℂ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    integral (LT (-d) * circuit d lam μ ^ n) = (-1 : ℂ)^(n-1) * lam^n * μ⁻¹ / (n+1)
proof:
:= by
  have hc := circuit_moment_coeff d (by omega) lam μ hμ n 1
  simp only [mul_one, zpow_neg_one] at hc
  have hs : (LT (-d) * circuit d lam μ ^ n).coeff 0 = (circuit d lam μ ^ n).coeff d := by
    simp only [LaurentPolynomial.T, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single_mul_apply, one_mul,
      add_zero, neg_neg]
  simp only [integral, hs, hc, eval_mul, eval_C]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  have hb : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..1, ((basic ^ n).coeff 1).eval (x : ℂ)) =
      (-1 : ℂ)^(n-1)/(n+1) := by
    simp_rw [← specialize_coeff, map_pow, basic_specialize]
    exact xzFamily_integral_marked n hn
  rw [hb]
  ring

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circuit_expansion
statement:
theorem circuit_expansion (d : ℤ) (lam μ : ℂ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) :
    circuit d lam μ = LC (C (lam*μ⁻¹) * X) * LT d + LC (C lam * (1-2*X)) -
      LC (C (lam*μ) * (1-X)) * LT (-d)
proof:
:= by
  have ht : (LT (-d) : Laurent) * LT d = 1 := by rw [← LaurentPolynomial.T_add]; simp
  have hu : (LC (C μ) : Laurent) * LC (C μ⁻¹) = 1 := by
    rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hμ, map_one, map_one]
  simp only [circuit, map_mul, map_sub, map_one, map_ofNat]
  linear_combination -LC (C lam) * LC X * (LC (C μ) * LC (C μ⁻¹)) * ht -
    LC (C lam) * LC X * hu

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circuit_coeff
statement:
theorem circuit_coeff (d k : ℤ) (lam μ : ℂ) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) :
    (circuit d lam μ).coeff k =
      (if k = d then C (lam*μ⁻¹) * X else 0) +
      (if k = 0 then C lam * (1-2*X) else 0) -
      (if k = -d then C (lam*μ) * (1-X) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [circuit_expansion d lam μ hμ]
  simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_sub,
    Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.sub_apply, ← LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C_mul_T,
    AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, LaurentPolynomial.C_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
  simp [eq_comm]

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circuit_spectrum
statement:
theorem circuit_spectrum (d : ℤ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (lam μ : ℂ) (hlam : lam ≠ 0) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) :
    (circuit d lam μ).coeff.support = {-d,0,d}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp : (C (lam*μ⁻¹) * X : ℂ[X]) ≠ 0 := by
    exact mul_ne_zero (by simpa using mul_ne_zero hlam (inv_ne_zero hμ)) X_ne_zero
  have hz : (C lam * (1-2*X) : ℂ[X]) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hh := congrArg (Polynomial.eval (0 : ℂ)) h
    simp [hlam] at hh
  have hn : (C (lam*μ) * (1-X) : ℂ[X]) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hh := congrArg (Polynomial.eval (0 : ℂ)) h
    simp [hlam, hμ] at hh
  ext k
  simp only [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, circuit_coeff d k lam μ hμ,
    Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
  by_cases hkd : k = d
  · subst k; simp [show d ≠ 0 by omega, show d ≠ -d by omega, hlam, hμ]
  by_cases hk0 : k = 0
  · subst k; simp [show (0 : ℤ) ≠ d by omega, show (0 : ℤ) ≠ -d by omega, hz]
  by_cases hkn : k = -d
  · subst k; simp [show -d ≠ d by omega, show -d ≠ 0 by omega]
    simpa using hn
  · simp [hkd, hk0, hkn]

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circuit_marked_ne_zero
statement:
theorem circuit_marked_ne_zero (d : ℤ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (lam μ : ℂ)
    (hlam : lam ≠ 0) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    integral (LT (-d) * circuit d lam μ ^ n) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [circuit_marked d hd lam μ hμ n hn]
  exact div_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num))
    (pow_ne_zero _ hlam)) (inv_ne_zero hμ)) (by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero n)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.circuit_family
statement:
theorem circuit_family (d : ℤ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (lam μ : ℂ) (hlam : lam ≠ 0) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) :
    (circuit d lam μ).coeff.support = {-d,0,d} ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → integral (circuit d lam μ ^ n) = 0) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → integral (LT (-d) * circuit d lam μ ^ n) =
      (-1 : ℂ)^(n-1) * lam^n * μ⁻¹ / (n+1))
proof:
:=
  ⟨circuit_spectrum d hd lam μ hlam hμ, circuit_pure d hd lam μ hμ,
    circuit_marked d hd lam μ hμ⟩

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.MatrixRepresentation.coefficient_mul
statement:
theorem coefficient_mul (ρ : MatrixRepresentation G ι) (σ : MatrixRepresentation G κ)

proof:

    ((ρ.continuous_entry i j).comp continuous_fst).mul ((continuous_apply j).comp continuous_snd)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.MatrixRepresentation.tensor_toMatrix

theorem tensor_toMatrix (ρ : MatrixRepresentation G ι) (σ : MatrixRepresentation G κ) (g : G) :

      ((Pi.basisFun ℂ ι).tensorProduct (Pi.basisFun ℂ κ))

theorem entry_as_coefficient (ρ : MatrixRepresentation G ι) (i j : ι) (g : G) :

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.MatrixRepresentation.coefficient_ofRepresentation
statement:
theorem coefficient_ofRepresentation (b : Module.Basis ι ℂ V) (ρ : Representation ℂ G V)
    (hρ : ∀ v, Continuous fun g => ρ g v) (l : V →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ) (v : V) (g : G) :
    (ofRepresentation b ρ hρ).coefficient (fun i => l (b i)) (b.repr v) g = l (ρ g v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coefficient_apply]
  change (∑ i, ∑ j, l (b i) * (LinearMap.toMatrixAlgEquiv b) (ρ g) i j * b.repr v j) = _
  simp only [LinearMap.toMatrixAlgEquiv_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  conv_rhs => rw [← b.sum_repr v]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
  have h : (∑ i, l (b i) * b.repr (ρ g (b j)) i) = l (ρ g (b j)) := by
    conv_rhs => rw [← b.sum_repr (ρ g (b j))]
    rw [map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  rw [h]
  simp [mul_comm]

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.representative_mul
statement:
theorem representative_mul {f h : C(G, ℂ)} (hf : f ∈ representativeSubmodule G)
    (hh : h ∈ representativeSubmodule G) : f * h ∈ representativeSubmodule G
proof:
:= by
  induction hf using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem f hf =>
    obtain ⟨n, ρ, i, j, rfl⟩ := hf
    induction hh using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem h hh =>
      obtain ⟨m, σ, k, l, rfl⟩ := hh
      exact entry_mem_representative (ρ.tensor σ) (i, k) (j, l)
    | zero => simp
    | add x y hx hy hx' hy' =>
      simpa [mul_add] using (representativeSubmodule G).add_mem hx' hy'
    | smul a x hx hx' =>
      simpa [mul_smul_comm] using (representativeSubmodule G).smul_mem a hx'
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy hx' hy' =>
    simpa [add_mul] using (representativeSubmodule G).add_mem hx' hy'
  | smul a x hx hx' =>
    simpa [smul_mul_assoc] using (representativeSubmodule G).smul_mem a hx'

proof:
:= by

  | mem f hf =>
    obtain ⟨n, ρ, i, j, rfl⟩ := hf
    exact entry_mem_representative ρ.conjugate i j
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy hx' hy' =>
    simpa using (representativeSubmodule G).add_mem hx' hy'
  | smul a x hx hx' =>
    simpa [star_smul] using (representativeSubmodule G).smul_mem (star a) hx'

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.coefficient_mem_representative
statement:
theorem coefficient_mem_representative {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (ρ : MatrixRepresentation G ι) (a v : ι → ℂ) :
    ρ.coefficient a v ∈ representativeFunctions (G := G)

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.representation_coefficient_mem

theorem representation_coefficient_mem {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℂ V]
    [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (ρ : Representation ℂ G V)
    (hρ : ∀ v, Continuous fun g => ρ g v) (l : V →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ) (v : V) :
    (⟨fun g => l (ρ g v), l.continuous_of_finiteDimensional.comp (hρ v)⟩ : C(G, ℂ)) ∈
      representativeFunctions (G := G)
proof:
:= by
  let b := Module.finBasis ℂ V
  convert coefficient_mem_representative (MatrixRepresentation.ofRepresentation b ρ hρ)
    (fun i => l (b i)) (b.repr v) using 1
  ext g
  exact (MatrixRepresentation.coefficient_ofRepresentation b ρ hρ l v g).symm

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.representative_eq_span_coefficients
statement:
theorem representative_eq_span_coefficients : representativeSubmodule G =
    Submodule.span ℂ (continuousRepresentationCoefficients G)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro f ⟨n, ρ, i, j, rfl⟩
    apply Submodule.subset_span
    exact ⟨n, ρ.toRepresentation, ρ.continuous_orbit, LinearMap.proj i,
      Pi.single j 1, ρ.entry_as_coefficient i j⟩
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro f ⟨n, ρ, hρ, l, v, hf⟩
    have heq : f = (⟨fun g => l (ρ g v),
        l.continuous_of_finiteDimensional.comp (hρ v)⟩ : C(G, ℂ)) :=
      ContinuousMap.ext hf
    rw [heq]
    exact representation_coefficient_mem ρ hρ l v

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.representative_comp

theorem representative_comp {f : C(H, ℂ)} (hf : f ∈ representativeFunctions (G := H))

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.pad_coeff

statement:
theorem pad_integral {k l : ℕ} (j : Fin k) (i : Fin l) (f : Laurent) :

proof:
:= by
  have hc := pad_coeff j i f 0
  simp only [map_zero] at hc
  simp only [multiIntegral, hc, padCoefficient_eval, cubeMeasure]
  rw [integral_comp_eval (μ := fun _ : Fin l => unitIntervalMeasure) (i := i)
    (f := fun t : ℝ => (f.coeff 0).eval (t : ℂ))
    ((f.coeff 0).continuous.comp Complex.continuous_ofReal).aestronglyMeasurable]
  simp only [unitIntervalMeasure, integral, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1),
    integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc]

name: XZMathieuSU2Counterexamples.padded_zero_support
statement:
theorem padded_zero_support {k l : ℕ} (j : Fin k) (i : Fin l) :
    (0 : Fin k → ℤ) ∈ (pad j i basic).coeff.support
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff]
  have hc := pad_coeff j i basic 0
  simp only [map_zero] at hc
